name: Almond Jelly
description: A delicate almond-flavored milk jelly cut into cubes and served chilled in syrup with lychee and mandarin segments.
ingredients: a generous handful of bamboo shoots
a handful of fresh scallion greens, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with toasted sesame oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the steamed buns and star anise until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the black vinegar with the pork stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 5 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with chives or a dusting of soy sauce.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: Bring your black vinegar to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
